subject: Finalize regional erase flow & ops ticketing for prompt-output purge
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nunez <alice@datascope.co>; securityops@acme-health.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed scope & schedule for prompt-output + logs purge

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, we want to confirm scope and a practical run window for the purge of prompt outputs, derivative artifacts, and the associated inference logs for the test workspace (DataScope-prod-eu). Proposal below: 

- Scope: all prompt-output artifacts and transient KV cache entries created between 2026-11-01 and 2027-02-18 for workspace DataScope-prod-eu.
- Logs: inference access logs and API request traces (30 days back from purge start) — obfuscated tokens preserved for audit where required.
- Execution window: Tue 2027-02-22 01:00–03:00 UTC (lowest traffic).
- Verification: ops will produce a JSON evidence bundle with file-level manifests and checksums, and a human-readable confirmation email.

I attached a short checklist the ops team will follow (sanitize-checklist.pdf). Can you confirm scope and the execution window works for DataScope compliance? If yes, we’ll open the ops ticket and schedule the run; I’ll loop in Marissa to provide the runbook and evidence link.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: sanitize-checklist.pdf]
From: Alice Nunez <alice@datascope.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: securityops@acme-health.com
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed scope & schedule for prompt-output + logs purge

Vanessa —

Thanks. Two quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Does the scope include derivative embeddings and any cached KV blobs used by our latency-tiered endpoints? We need all service-side cached state erased.
2) For logs: we need proof that request-level traces (request id, timestamp, and action) were removed — but we also require a redacted audit trail that shows a before/after line count per object.

If you can provide a sample evidence bundle and a pre-populated verification email we can use to confirm on our side, that would help speed approval.

—Alice
Alice Nunez
Head of Data & Security, DataScope
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Alice Nunez <alice@datascope.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed scope & schedule for prompt-output + logs purge

Hi all —

Ops readout and plan below. I’m the engineer who will own execution and evidence packaging.

Execution plan (high level):
- Create ops ticket: 4521 (internal) — will appear in runbook and include play-by-play.
- Snapshot manifest: enumerate S3 prefixes for DataScope-prod-eu and mark objects matching prompt-output and kvcache pattern.
- Two-phase deletion: 
  1) Mark & soft-delete (move to quarantine prefix) to allow a 2hr verification window.
  2) Final expunge after verification (irreversible).
- Logs: we will remove request/trace objects and produce a redaction manifest that lists object keys and a before/after line count. Redacted copies will be retained only in the evidence bundle (no raw payload).
- TTL/Cache: any in-memory KV shards will be zeroed and tombstones propagated; persistent KV shards will be squashed and the prior segments erased.

Attachments: ops_ticket_4521.log (created during planning) — contains the ticket stub and scheduled task IDs.

I will generate the evidence bundle to S3 at: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/erase-evidence/2027/02/22/4521/ and produce erase-evidence-20270222.json with checksums.

We will also attach the redaction manifest as part of the final bundle. Plan to start the soft-delete at Tue 2027-02-22 01:00 UTC as proposed.

If DataScope approves, we’ll proceed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: ops_ticket_4521.log]
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nunez <alice@datascope.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed scope & schedule for prompt-output + logs purge

Alice —

Thanks Marissa — that plan looks good. For approval we’ll need two small things from ops before kick-off: 

1) A short pre-populated customer verification email that we can use to acknowledge completion (I prepared some language and attached it as verification-email-drafts.txt).
2) A minimal sample evidence bundle (small JSON) showing the manifest format and the redaction manifest so DataScope can validate schema against their internal audit tool.

If you can drop those into the Drive runbook folder, I’ll loop in DataScope’s security team to sign off. Once we have a green light I’ll trigger the ticket and mark the run in the calendar.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: verification-email-drafts.txt]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nunez <alice@datascope.co>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 17:30:00 -0800
Subject: Completed: purge executed & evidence bundle delivered (Ticket 4521)

Hi Alice / team —

Purge execution complete. Summary: 
- Soft-delete window started: 2027-02-22 01:00 UTC.
- Final expunge completed: 2027-02-22 02:37 UTC.
- Objects removed: 18,432 prompt-output artifacts; 4,218 KV shards; 2,390 log segments (redacted copies retained in evidence bundle only).

Artifacts delivered: 
- erase-evidence-20270222.json (manifest + checksums) [attachment: erase-evidence-20270222.json]
- redaction-manifest.csv (object keys and before/after counts) — stored in S3 run folder.
- ops_ticket_4521.log (runbook trace).

Evidence is available at: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/erase-evidence/2027/02/22/4521/  (signed with run id 4521).

Next steps for DataScope: please confirm receipt and use the verification-email-drafts.txt to acknowledge on your side. We can also provide an HMAC-signed digest of the manifest for extra assurance.

If you’d like we can schedule a 30-min post-mortem to walk through the manifests and the redaction proofs.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Engineering, Redwood Inference
[attachment: erase-evidence-20270222.json]
